decision: Accept reviewed texture stage into integration; combined build acceptance pending

findings.observation: PNG/JPEG header dimensions are checked; pixel payload decode integrity is not established. Valid header is not proof of valid image payload.
findings.required: Compare production import of header-valid truncated image against pinned original; preserve source behavior and document display failures accurately.

findings.observation: 16MiB per asset and 64M pixel limits do not establish a combined retained asset byte budget. TextureRecord owns a Vec per material.
findings.required: Bound total retained asset memory and account for duplicate ownership; reuse identical asset validation rather than repeated decoding.

unchanged_evidence: 24 retained bounded comparisons remain useful; no full SKP parity claim. No broad test repeated for this review.

independent_review.corrupt_image_behavior: Original publishes a material whose QImage is null; Rust refuses invalid pixels. Explicit integrity correction, not malformed-image parity.
independent_review.memory: 256MiB total retained raw bytes including per-material copies; header and decode checked once per equal embedded identity. Cold duplication remains, no zero-copy claim.
